name: manjappada-masters
description: Manjappada Masters — Club Master Football Tournament

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.db:d1:local: npx wrangler d1 execute manjappada_masters --local --file=database/d1/schema.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute manjappada_masters --local --file=database/d1/seed.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute manjappada_masters --local --file=database/d1/migrations/001_registrations.sql
scripts.db:d1:remote: npx wrangler d1 execute manjappada_masters --remote --file=database/d1/schema.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute manjappada_masters --remote --file=database/d1/seed.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute manjappada_masters --remote --file=database/d1/migrations/001_registrations.sql
scripts.db:d1:migrate: npx wrangler d1 execute manjappada_masters --remote --file=database/d1/migrations/001_registrations.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute manjappada_masters --remote --file=database/d1/migrations/002_captain_email.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute manjappada_masters --remote --file=database/d1/migrations/003_settings.sql && npx wrangler d1 execute manjappada_masters --remote --file=database/d1/migrations/004_team_accounts.sql
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy
